Engine.DumpLuaAPI.description: Prints the live qualified Lua API names to the console and returns the count.

Engine.GetBuildConfiguration.description: Returns Debug or Release according to the compiled executable.

Engine.GetBuildIdentity.description: Returns the executable milestone, compiled configuration, Git identity, dirty state, and generated UTC timestamp.

Engine.GetBuildStep.description: Returns the repository milestone identifier embedded before compilation.

Engine.GetGitCommit.description: Returns the Git commit recorded before compilation, or unavailable when Git metadata was absent.

Engine.GetLastSafetyReport.description: Returns the last in-process safety smoke-test summary and report location.

Engine.GetLuaApiCount.description: Returns the number of unique Lua functions registered by the current runtime.

Engine.GetLuaApiName.description: Returns one exact qualified Lua API name from the live registry.

Engine.RunSafetySmokeTests.returns: passed: boolean, summary: string, reportPath: string
Engine.RunSafetySmokeTests.description: Runs non-destructive handle-generation and body-dependent cleanup smoke tests.

Entity.Destroy.description: Destroys an entity subtree and invalidates the generation-checked handle.

Entity.GetMesh.returns: assetPath: string|nil, red: number, green: number, blue: number, visible: boolean, normalize: boolean, doubleSided: boolean, blenderCoordinates: boolean
Entity.GetMesh.description: Reads the current mesh component, including whether Blender-coordinate import mode is active.

Entity.SetMesh.arguments: (entity: EntityHandle, assetPath: string, red?: number, green?: number, blue?: number, normalize?: boolean, doubleSided?: boolean, blenderCoordinates?: boolean)
Entity.SetMesh.description: Assigns an OBJ or GLB mesh to an entity. With blenderCoordinates=true, OBJ positions/normals authored as Blender X left/right, Y forward/backward, Z height are deterministically converted at the import boundary while preserving authored 1:1 scale. GLB imports preserve authored node transforms, skinning and looped animation playback.

Entity.SetMeshNodeAnchoredWorldPose.arguments: (entity: EntityHandle, rootNodeName: string, anchorNodeName: string, worldX: number, worldY: number, worldZ: number, localRotationXDegrees?: number, localRotationYDegrees?: number, localRotationZDegrees?: number)
Entity.SetMeshNodeAnchoredWorldPose.description: Moves a GLB node subtree as one authored rigid assembly so a named descendant anchor lands at an authoritative world position while a local rotation delta is composed around that anchor. Intended for modular assemblies such as a wheel root anchored by its wheel-spin pivot without destroying authored caliper/wheel/tire placement or left/right facing.

Environment.GetSunDirection.returns: x: number, y: number, z: number
Environment.GetSunDirection.description: Returns the current normalized world-space direction from the scene toward the procedural sun.

Environment.GetTimeOfDay.description: Returns the current procedural environment time of day in wrapped hours [0,24).

Environment.GetTimeScale.description: Returns simulated environment seconds advanced per real second.

Environment.IsCycleEnabled.description: Returns whether the procedural day/night clock advances automatically.

Environment.SetCycleEnabled.description: Enables or pauses automatic procedural day/night progression.

Environment.SetTimeOfDay.description: Sets the procedural environment time of day in hours; values wrap into the 24-hour clock.

Environment.SetTimeScale.description: Sets day/night preview speed. 1 is real time, 60 advances one simulated minute per real second, 1440 completes a day in one real minute.

Module.AssetExists.description: Checks whether a safe path beneath the active module's Assets directory identifies a regular file.

Module.GetAssetCount.description: Counts currently discovered module assets matching optional extension, directory-prefix and filename-prefix filters.

Module.GetAssetIndexRevision.description: Returns the active module asset-index revision. It changes when the once-per-second Assets scan observes file additions, removals, renames or write/size changes.

Module.GetAssetPath.arguments: (oneBasedIndex: integer, extension?: string, directoryPrefix?: string, fileNamePrefix?: string)
Module.GetAssetPath.description: Returns one stable module-asset-relative path from the current filtered asset index.

Module.GetLatestAsset.description: Returns the most recently written asset path matching the optional filters.

Module.RefreshAssetIndex.description: Forces an immediate active-module Assets rescan and returns the resulting revision. Normal runtime refresh is already rate-limited to once per second.

Module.SelectAssetFile.description: Opens the Windows mesh picker and accepts an existing .obj or .glb already contained by the active module's Assets directory.

Module.WriteSaveText.description: Writes at most 2 MiB of text to a safe .lua, .json or .txt path beneath the active module's private Saves directory.

Physics.ClearBodyInertiaLocalOverride.description: Clears an explicit local-inertia override so collision geometry may derive the body's inertia again.

Physics.DestroyBody.description: Destroys dependent vehicles, constraints, and colliders before invalidating the body handle.

Physics.GetBodyCenterOfMassLocal.returns: x: number, y: number, z: number | nil, nil, nil
Physics.GetBodyCenterOfMassLocal.description: Returns the body's physical center-of-mass offset in authored body/entity-local coordinates. The body origin remains a creator/reference datum and does not have to coincide with the COM.

Physics.GetBodyCenterOfMassWorld.returns: x: number, y: number, z: number | nil, nil, nil
Physics.GetBodyCenterOfMassWorld.description: Returns the current physical center of mass in world coordinates after applying body rotation to the authored local COM offset.

Physics.GetBodyInertiaLocal.returns: pitchInertiaKgM2, yawInertiaKgM2, rollInertiaKgM2 | nil, nil, nil
Physics.GetBodyInertiaLocal.description: Returns the rigid body's active diagonal local inertia tensor. Heritage native axes are X=pitch, Y=yaw, Z=roll.

Physics.GetColliderSurface.returns: materialName: string|nil, materialId: integer|nil, wetness: number|nil
Physics.GetColliderSurface.description: Reads the physical surface identity carried by one collider.

Physics.GetStaticBoxSceneCount.description: Returns the number of static collision proxy boxes currently owned by the Lua runtime.

Physics.GetStaticTriangleSceneCount.description: Returns the number of static drive-surface triangles currently participating in physics raycasts.

Physics.GetSurfaceEnvironment.returns: wetness: number, ambientTemperatureC: number, surfaceTemperatureC: number, surfaceTemperatureOverrideEnabled: boolean
Physics.GetSurfaceEnvironment.description: Returns the live world-surface weather inputs consumed by tire wet/winter/thermal simulation.

Physics.GetSurfacePresentation.description: Returns read-only driven-surface presentation telemetry: deformable track marks/particles, TIRE16 pressure-resolved continuous tire-mark segment count, cumulative emission/contact counts, rut intensity, normalized rolling/spray/dust/debris audio mechanism intensities, plus TIRE15C world-rubber cell/chunk/contact/generation counters. Presentation state never feeds tire or collision physics; the rubber counters describe authoritative shared track state.

Physics.IsBodyInertiaLocalOverridden.description: Returns whether the body currently uses an explicit local-inertia override rather than collider-derived inertia.

Physics.LoadStaticBoxScene.description: Loads the temporary Step 29J.2 OBJ collision-proxy scene. Each object/group with referenced faces becomes one native axis-aligned static box. Returns -1 on error; inspect Physics.GetLastError().

Physics.LoadStaticTriangleScene.returns: triangleCount: integer, spawnX?: number, spawnGroundY?: number, spawnZ?: number, spawnMode: string
Physics.LoadStaticTriangleScene.description: Loads exact static query triangles from .glb or legacy .obj. GLB scenes read collision-marked nodes and SPAWN_PLAYER from the same container; OBJ keeps the optional second visual path for legacy spawn metadata. Returns -1 on error; inspect Physics.GetLastError().

Physics.Raycast.arguments: (originX: number, originY: number, originZ: number, directionX: number, directionY: number, directionZ: number, maxDistance: number, layerMask?: integer, includeTriggers?: boolean, ignoredBody?: BodyHandle)
Physics.Raycast.returns: hit: boolean, collider: ColliderHandle, body: BodyHandle, distance: number, pointX: number, pointY: number, pointZ: number, normalX: number, normalY: number, normalZ: number, trigger: boolean, surfaceName: string, surfaceId: integer, surfaceWetness: number
Physics.Raycast.description: Closest-hit raycast. Step 29F appends the contacted collider's surface identity and wetness without changing the first eleven return values.

Physics.SetBodyCenterOfMassLocal.arguments: (body: BodyHandle, x: number, y: number, z: number)
Physics.SetBodyCenterOfMassLocal.description: Sets the physical center-of-mass offset without moving authored body/entity coordinates, colliders, wheel mounts, suspension hardpoints, or visual children.

Physics.SetBodyInertiaLocal.description: Sets an explicit positive diagonal local inertia tensor. The override remains authoritative over collider-derived inertia until cleared.

Physics.SetColliderSurface.description: Assigns a generic physical surface identity and 0..1 wetness to one collider. Valid materials: default, asphalt, gravel, dirt, grass, snow, ice, kerb/curb, painted_line.

Physics.SetSurfaceEnvironment.arguments: (wetness: number, ambientTemperatureC: number, surfaceTemperatureC: number, surfaceTemperatureOverrideEnabled: boolean)
Physics.SetSurfaceEnvironment.description: Sets bounded global surface wetness and live air/road temperatures. Scene-authored local wetness/temperature remains the base when no road-temperature override is active.

Physics.UnloadStaticBoxScene.description: Destroys all native static bodies/entities created by Physics.LoadStaticBoxScene for the active Lua runtime.

Physics.UnloadStaticTriangleScene.description: Clears the read-only static triangle drive-surface scene for the active physics world.

UI.Button.arguments: (label: string, widthPixels?: number, heightPixels?: number, centered?: boolean)
UI.Button.description: Draws a button. It remains centered by default; pass centered=false when composing responsive rows from UI.GetAvailableWidth().

UI.GetAvailableWidth.description: Returns the horizontal content width remaining at the current cursor position.

UI.InputFloat.arguments: (label: string, value: number, minimum?: number, maximum?: number, step?: number, stepFast?: number, format?: string)
UI.InputFloat.description: Draws a visible floating-point numeric editor for exact setup values. Values are clamped to the supplied engine-safe range; step and stepFast control the small/large increment buttons without quantizing typed values.

UI.InputText.description: Draws a bounded single-line text editor. The native buffer is rebuilt from Lua-owned state each frame and is capped at 4096 characters.

UI.PlotLines.description: Draws an auto-scaled native line plot from up to 512 numeric arguments. Intended for bounded diagnostic series rather than gameplay rendering.

UI.SliderFloat.arguments: (label: string, value: number, minimum: number, maximum: number, format?: string)
UI.SliderFloat.description: Draws a draggable numeric slider. Step 29J.2 also supports double-clicking the slider to switch it into exact keyboard-entry mode; Enter commits and clicking away exits text mode.

Vegetation.AddInstance.arguments: (speciesId: string, globalX: number, globalY: number, globalZ: number, yawDeg: number=0, scale: number=1, variationSeed: number=0)
Vegetation.AddInstance.description: Stores a large-world vegetation instance in 64 m chunks with 16-bit local placement.

Vegetation.ClearInstances.description: Clears vegetation placements while preserving registered species.

Vegetation.GetLastError.description: Returns the most recent vegetation registry validation error.

Vegetation.GetRepresentation.description: Returns the planned best representation band for a species at a distance, respecting available octahedral/coverage capabilities.

Vegetation.GetStats.description: Returns species, instance, chunk, packed-byte, chunk-size and quantization diagnostics.

Vegetation.IsAvailable.description: Returns whether the native VEG01 vegetation registry is available.

Vegetation.RegisterSpecies.arguments: (id: string, kind: string, clusterOctahedral: boolean=false, wholePlantOctahedral: boolean=false, terrainCoverage: boolean=false)
Vegetation.RegisterSpecies.description: Registers one tree/shrub/grass/reed/flower/crop/generic species using native type-specific default LOD distances.

Vegetation.Reset.description: Clears vegetation species, instances, chunks, wind state and errors for a clean module reload.

Vegetation.SetSpeciesLod.arguments: (id: string, detailedEndM: number, mergedClusterEndM: number, wholePlantEndM: number, terrainCoverageEndM: number)
Vegetation.SetSpeciesLod.description: Overrides monotonically increasing LOD distance boundaries for a vegetation species.

Vegetation.SetSpeciesWindResponse.arguments: (id: string, trunk: number, branch: number, foliage: number)
Vegetation.SetSpeciesWindResponse.description: Sets normalized hierarchical wind response weights for one species.

Vegetation.SetWind.arguments: (xMps: number, yMps: number, zMps: number, gust01: number=0, turbulence01: number=0)
Vegetation.SetWind.description: Sets the shared vegetation wind field input used by future hierarchical wind rendering.

Vehicle.ClearDynamicsLab.description: Stops and removes the retained native dynamics capture for one vehicle.

Vehicle.CompileDefinitionV2.returns: valid: boolean, currentSolverReady: boolean, providerId: string, summary: string, diagnostics: string
Vehicle.CompileDefinitionV2.description: Copies a bounded authored table into native data, resolves component references, and reports the matching runtime provider without retaining Lua pointers.

Vehicle.Create.description: Creates a generation-checked vehicle attached to a dynamic chassis body. Inspect the handler for all optional tuning arguments.

Vehicle.CreateFromDefinitionV2.arguments: (definition: VehicleDefinitionV2 table, chassisBody: BodyHandle, highRateHertz?: number, maximumDriveForce?: number, maximumBrakeForce?: number, maximumSteerAngleDegrees?: number, tireFriction?: number, lateralStiffness?: number, rollingResistance?: number)
Vehicle.CreateFromDefinitionV2.returns: vehicle: VehicleHandle, providerId: string, message: string
Vehicle.CreateFromDefinitionV2.description: Compiles a version-2 component graph and creates it through the selected native provider. Returns zero without flattening unsupported topologies.

Vehicle.EstimateChassisFlex.arguments: (massKg: number, wheelbaseM: number, frontTrackM: number, rearTrackM: number, centerOfMassHeightM: number, modelYear: integer, construction: string)
Vehicle.EstimateChassisFlex.description: Creates a versioned low-confidence first-mode chassis-flex estimate from broad construction and package data. The result carries provenance/confidence and is not a factory measurement.

Vehicle.EstimateMacPhersonHardpoints.arguments: (wheelCenterX: number, wheelCenterY: number, wheelCenterZ: number, referencePackageScaleM: number, casterDegrees: number, steeringAxisInclinationDegrees: number)
Vehicle.EstimateMacPhersonHardpoints.description: Builds the versioned low-confidence estimated_macpherson_road_v1 eight-point hardpoint package from chassis reference-package scale and alignment assumptions. The scale is suspension authoring data and must not be regenerated from a later wheel/tire swap.

Vehicle.EstimateMassProperties.arguments: (totalMassKg, wheelbaseM, frontTrackM, rearTrackM, centerOfMassHeightM, frontStaticLoadFraction, leftStaticLoadFraction, massClassId)
Vehicle.EstimateMassProperties.description: Builds a bounded, provenance-labelled low-confidence mass-property estimate containing total mass, local COM, pitch/yaw/roll inertia and static axle/side masses.

Vehicle.EstimateTrailingArmHardpoints.arguments: (wheelCenterX: number, wheelCenterY: number, wheelCenterZ: number, referencePackageScaleM: number)
Vehicle.EstimateTrailingArmHardpoints.description: Builds the versioned low-confidence estimated_trailing_arm_torsion_bar_road_v1 five-point trailing-arm/separate-damper hardpoint package from chassis reference-package scale. Returned coordinates are estimates and can be replaced point-by-point by stronger asset or measured evidence.

Vehicle.ExportDynamicsLabCsv.description: Exports all retained native samples below the active module's private Saves/DynamicsLab directory.

Vehicle.GetAntiRollBar.returns: leftWheel, rightWheel, stiffness, damping, leftLever, rightLever, leftMotionRatio, rightMotionRatio, maximumWheelForce, enabled, twistRadians, twistRateRadPerSec, torqueNm, leftWheelForceN, rightWheelForceN, totalAbsoluteWheelForceN
Vehicle.GetAntiRollBar.description: Returns authored anti-roll-bar parameters plus the most recent high-rate torsional state and wheel-force corrections.

Vehicle.GetAntiRollBarCount.description: Returns the number of configured anti-roll-bar coupling slots for the vehicle.

Vehicle.GetChassisFlexState.description: Returns authored chassis-flex parameters plus live FP64 torsional twist/rate, front/rear reaction moments, structural torques, energy and front/rear section twist diagnostics.

Vehicle.GetDynamicsLabSeries.arguments: (vehicle: VehicleHandle, metricName: string, oneBasedWheelIndex?: integer, maximumPoints?: integer)
Vehicle.GetDynamicsLabSeries.description: Returns at most 240 chronological peak-preserving plot values for one supported global or per-wheel dynamics metric.

Vehicle.GetDynamicsLabSummary.returns: recording, complete, samples, capacity, wheels, durationSeconds, captureHertz, peakSpeedKph, peakRollDegps, peakPitchDegps, peakYawDegps, peakSuspensionSpeedMps, peakSlipRatio, peakSlipAngleDeg, peakGripPercent, minimumGroundedLoadN, maximumGroundedLoadN, contactLossEvents, peakTravelStopForceN, peakDamperDissipationW, peakUnsprungVelocityMps, peakTireDeflectionMm, peakTireRadialDissipationW, peakAbsoluteCamberDeg, peakAbsoluteToeDeg
Vehicle.GetDynamicsLabSummary.description: Returns bounded-capture status and extrema, including suspension travel-stop loads, damper energy rate, wheel-hop speed, radial tire deflection, radial damping power, camber and toe calculated from authoritative native high-rate samples.

Vehicle.GetWheelAlignment.returns: localCamberDegrees, localToeDegrees, casterOverrideEnabled, casterDegrees | nil, nil, nil, nil
Vehicle.GetWheelAlignment.description: Returns the active per-corner alignment setup used by suspension kinematics.

Vehicle.GetWheelContactDiagnostic.returns: statusName, statusId, lossTransitionCount, rayCandidateCount, exactTestCount, staticTriangleCandidateCount, staticSceneLoaded, originInsideStaticSceneBounds, rayBoundsOverlapStaticScene, selectedHitWasStaticTriangle, rawSupportDistanceM, suspensionBottomed, bottomOutPenetrationM
Vehicle.GetWheelContactDiagnostic.description: Returns the native reason and query evidence for the wheel's latest support result. Diagnostics distinguish valid support, bottom-out, detected road with zero load, a surface behind the ray origin, scene-boundary exits, missing geometry, broadphase misses, narrowphase misses and support beyond suspension travel.

Vehicle.GetWheelFitment.returns: enabled, referenceOffsetEtMm, installedOffsetEtMm, spacerThicknessMm, rimDiameterIn, rimWidthIn, tireWidthMm, tireAspectRatio, tireRimDiameterIn, nominalTireRadiusM, outwardCenterlineDeltaM | nil...
Vehicle.GetWheelFitment.description: Returns reference/installed fitment plus the resolved nominal tire radius and outward wheel-centerline displacement.

Vehicle.GetWheelFitmentGeometry.description: Returns resolved reference hub face, installed mounting plane, installed wheel centerline, tire inboard/outboard envelope, and live steering-axis ground geometry including scrub radius and mechanical trail. Suspension hardpoints remain immutable.

Vehicle.GetWheelState.returns: 169 values; inspect Vehicles/Telemetry.lua for the canonical unpack order
Vehicle.GetWheelState.description: Returns wheel suspension force components, damper dissipation, unsprung velocity, radial tire deflection/power, advanced tire force telemetry, brake/driver-aid state, contact collider, and detected surface data, plus TIRE03 turn-slip/contact-twist diagnostics, TIRE04 free/loaded/effective rolling radii and finite footprint, TIRE05 enveloped-road plus translational rigid-ring state, TIRE06 adaptive 2D footprint/split-surface diagnostics plus rigid-ring yaw/wind-up state, TIRE07 tread/carcass/gas/wheel-rim temperatures, dynamic inflation pressure, brake-to-rim and rim-to-carcass heat, thermal grip/stiffness scales and heat-flow diagnostics, TIRE08 spatial tread temperature/wear/flat-spot state, TIRE09 material-fixed visual flat-spot sector, and TIRE10 average/contact tread-radius loss, signed contact-radius variation and native contact normal for physical flat-spot/visual contact-plane coupling, plus TIRE11 per-contact/average contamination, organic/dirt/gravel/rubber/mud pickup channels, contamination grip scale and cleaning rate, plus TIRE12 road-water depth, retained tread water, drainage demand/water-wedge state, progressive hydroplaning/pavement-contact fraction, hydrodynamic lift/drag, wet-friction scale and classical hydroplaning-speed diagnostic, plus TIRE13 snow/ice footprint fractions, winter friction/stiffness response, packed-snow state, interface melt-film depth, stud/interlock contributions and local winter surface temperature, plus TIRE14 gravel/dirt footprint fraction, loose-layer sinkage/contact pressure, tread effectiveness, granular shear capacity/forces, lateral bulldozing, plowing/compaction and MF-base friction scale, plus TIRE15 deformable-terrain footprint fraction, sinkage, persistent rut depth, compaction, moisture, loose depth, terrain shear/bulldozing/plowing forces, residual MF scale and shared SurfaceField pass count.

Vehicle.GetWheelSuspensionGeometry.returns: provider, steeringAxisX, steeringAxisY, steeringAxisZ, staticCamberDegrees, camberGainDegreesPerM, camberProgressionDegreesPerM2, staticToeDegrees, toeGainDegreesPerM, toeProgressionDegreesPerM2
Vehicle.GetWheelSuspensionGeometry.description: Reads the exact native steering-axis and alignment-curve description assigned to one contact unit.

Vehicle.GetWheelSuspensionModel.returns: provider, springPreloadN, springRateNPerM, springProgressionNPerM2, bumpDampingNsPerM, bumpHighSpeedDampingNsPerM, bumpDampingKneeVelocityMps, reboundDampingNsPerM, reboundHighSpeedDampingNsPerM, reboundDampingKneeVelocityMps, bumpStopEngagementM, bumpStopRateNPerM, bumpStopProgressionNPerM2, droopStopEngagementM, droopStopRateNPerM, motionRatio, maximumForceN
Vehicle.GetWheelSuspensionModel.description: Reads the exact native nonlinear suspension description assigned to one wheel so live tools never infer state from Lua defaults.

Vehicle.GetWheelTelemetry.description: Returns one named table containing the complete current wheel snapshot used by Racing United telemetry: suspension/contact forces, tire slip/geometry/ring/thermal/wear/contamination/wet/winter/granular/deformable-terrain state, TIRE15C deposited/loose track-rubber state and rubber friction scale, contact-query diagnostics, and authoritative upright orientation. This is the preferred extensible API; legacy GetWheelState remains only for compatibility.

Vehicle.GetWheelTireModel.returns: nominalLoad, peakFriction, longitudinalStiffness, corneringStiffness, loadSensitivity, longitudinalRelaxationLength, lateralRelaxationLength, wheelInertia, pneumaticTrail, stiffnessLoadExponent, longitudinalShapeFactor, lateralShapeFactor, longitudinalCurvatureFactor, lateralCurvatureFactor, combinedSlipExponent, pneumaticTrailFalloff
Vehicle.GetWheelTireModel.description: Reads the exact native tire description currently assigned to one wheel so scripts and diagnostics do not need to guess which profile is active.

Vehicle.GetWheelUnsprungMassModel.description: Reads the exact native scalar unsprung-mass and radial-tire description assigned to one wheel/contact unit.

Vehicle.GetWheelUprightPose.returns: camberDegrees, toeDegrees, localRotationXDegrees, localRotationYDegrees, localRotationZDegrees, worldSteeringAxisX, worldSteeringAxisY, worldSteeringAxisZ, worldForwardX, worldForwardY, worldForwardZ, worldRightX, worldRightY, worldRightZ, worldUpX, worldUpY, worldUpZ
Vehicle.GetWheelUprightPose.description: Returns the authoritative native upright orientation evaluated at the current suspension travel and Ackermann steering angle.

Vehicle.InspectAssetMetadata.description: Inspects Heritage semantic metadata in a vehicle GLB, including authored vehicle parts, suspension hardpoint nodes, and explicit wheel-fitment datums. Wheel datums report corner/role, chassis-local position, local +X axis, provenance, and confidence without assuming arbitrary WH_* origins have engineering meaning.

Vehicle.SetAntiRollBar.arguments: (vehicle, barIndex, leftWheel, rightWheel, torsionalStiffnessNmPerRad, torsionalDampingNmsPerRad, leftLeverArmM, rightLeverArmM, leftLinkMotionRatio, rightLinkMotionRatio, maximumWheelForceN, enabled)
Vehicle.SetAntiRollBar.description: Creates or replaces a reusable torsional anti-roll bar slot coupling two wheel/contact units. Indices are Lua 1-based.

Vehicle.SetChassisTorsionalCompliance.arguments: (vehicle: VehicleHandle, enabled: boolean, torsionalRigidityNmPerDegree: number, torsionalDampingNmsPerRad: number, effectiveTorsionalInertiaKgM2: number, torsionAxisLocalY: number, frontReferenceLocalZ: number, rearReferenceLocalZ: number, maximumTwistDegrees: number)
Vehicle.SetChassisTorsionalCompliance.description: Atomically enables/disables the reusable first chassis torsion mode. Gross rigid-body roll remains separate; this mechanism flexes the virtual suspension pickup frame.

Vehicle.SetInputs.arguments: (vehicle: VehicleHandle, throttle: number, brake: number, steering: number, handbrake?: number)
Vehicle.SetInputs.description: Sets normalized driver inputs for one native vehicle.

Vehicle.SetTireModel.arguments: (vehicle: VehicleHandle, nominalLoad: number, peakFriction: number, longitudinalStiffness: number, corneringStiffness: number, loadSensitivity: number, longitudinalRelaxationLength: number, lateralRelaxationLength: number, wheelInertia: number, pneumaticTrail: number, stiffnessLoadExponent?: number, longitudinalShapeFactor?: number, lateralShapeFactor?: number, longitudinalCurvatureFactor?: number, lateralCurvatureFactor?: number, combinedSlipExponent?: number, pneumaticTrailFalloff?: number)
Vehicle.SetTireModel.description: Configures the Step 29H vehicle-wide default road-tire profile and intentionally reapplies it to every existing wheel for backward-compatible all-wheel tuning.

Vehicle.SetWheelAlignment.arguments: (vehicle: VehicleHandle, oneBasedWheelIndex: integer, localCamberDegrees: number, localToeDegrees: number, casterOverrideEnabled: boolean, casterDegrees: number)
Vehicle.SetWheelAlignment.description: Applies a per-corner setup alignment independently from the authored neutral wheel mount. Camber/toe are signed native local values; caster adjusts the steering-axis target without moving suspension hardpoints.

Vehicle.SetWheelFitment.arguments: (vehicle: VehicleHandle, oneBasedWheelIndex: integer, enabled: boolean, referenceOffsetEtMm: number, installedOffsetEtMm: number, spacerThicknessMm: number, rimDiameterIn: number, rimWidthIn: number, tireWidthMm: number, tireAspectRatio: number, tireRimDiameterIn: number)
Vehicle.SetWheelFitment.description: Applies installed wheel/tire fitment to one contact unit while preserving its authored reference mount and all chassis suspension hardpoints. ET and spacers move only the installed wheel centerline; tire size updates nominal rolling radius.

Vehicle.SetWheelSuspensionGeometry.arguments: (vehicle: VehicleHandle, oneBasedWheelIndex: integer, steeringAxisX: number, steeringAxisY: number, steeringAxisZ: number, staticCamberDegrees: number, camberGainDegreesPerM: number, camberProgressionDegreesPerM2: number, staticToeDegrees: number, toeGainDegreesPerM: number, toeProgressionDegreesPerM2: number)
Vehicle.SetWheelSuspensionGeometry.description: Atomically validates and applies the selected contact unit's local steering axis plus signed quadratic camber and toe curves.

Vehicle.SetWheelSuspensionHardpoints.arguments: (vehicle: VehicleHandle, oneBasedWheelIndex: integer, providerId: string, hardpoints: table)
Vehicle.SetWheelSuspensionHardpoints.description: Atomically activates a supported hardpoint suspension provider on one existing wheel using named chassis-local hardpoints while preserving the wheel’s existing alignment/tuning fields. Current supported mechanisms include MacPherson strut and trailing-arm/torsion-bar geometry.

Vehicle.SetWheelSuspensionModel.arguments: (vehicle: VehicleHandle, oneBasedWheelIndex: integer, springPreloadN: number, springRateNPerM: number, springProgressionNPerM2: number, bumpDampingNsPerM: number, bumpHighSpeedDampingNsPerM: number, bumpDampingKneeVelocityMps: number, reboundDampingNsPerM: number, reboundHighSpeedDampingNsPerM: number, reboundDampingKneeVelocityMps: number, bumpStopEngagementM: number, bumpStopRateNPerM: number, bumpStopProgressionNPerM2: number, droopStopEngagementM: number, droopStopRateNPerM: number, motionRatio: number, maximumForceN: number)
Vehicle.SetWheelSuspensionModel.description: Atomically validates and applies an independent healthy nonlinear suspension tune to one wheel/contact unit. Geometry and tire data are unchanged.

Vehicle.SetWheelTireModel.arguments: (vehicle: VehicleHandle, oneBasedWheelIndex: integer, nominalLoad: number, peakFriction: number, longitudinalStiffness: number, corneringStiffness: number, loadSensitivity: number, longitudinalRelaxationLength: number, lateralRelaxationLength: number, wheelInertia: number, pneumaticTrail: number, stiffnessLoadExponent?: number, longitudinalShapeFactor?: number, lateralShapeFactor?: number, longitudinalCurvatureFactor?: number, lateralCurvatureFactor?: number, combinedSlipExponent?: number, pneumaticTrailFalloff?: number)
Vehicle.SetWheelTireModel.description: Assigns an independent advanced road-tire description to one wheel/contact unit without modifying any other wheel.

Vehicle.SetWheelUnsprungMassModel.arguments: (vehicle: VehicleHandle, oneBasedWheelIndex: integer, effectiveMassKg: number, tireRadialStiffnessNPerM: number, tireRadialDampingNsPerM: number, maximumTireDeflectionM: number, maximumNormalForceN: number)
Vehicle.SetWheelUnsprungMassModel.description: Atomically configures the selected contact unit's scalar unsprung mass and radial tire compliance. Zero effective mass selects the legacy massless path.

Vehicle.StartDynamicsLab.description: Clears any earlier run and starts an opt-in bounded native dynamics capture at or below the vehicle high-rate solver frequency.

Vehicle.StopDynamicsLab.description: Stops recording while retaining every captured sample and summary.

Entity.SetMeshNodeTireFlexibleRingFromWh.arguments: (entity: EntityHandle, nodeName: string, vehicle: VehicleHandle, wheelIndex: number)
Entity.SetMeshNodeTireFlexibleRingFromWh.description: Native-to-native tire presentation bridge. Samples bounded distributed collision contact, solves one reduced-order flexible-ring field with the authoritative wheel state, and publishes only the final displacement field to the authored tire mesh node.
